name: Ulte Mail Sync – Mailchimp Abandoned Cart & Order Sync for WooCommerce
author: stockeven

sections.description:
Ulte Mail Sync connects a WooCommerce store to Mailchimp e-commerce. Orders, abandoned carts and products reach Mailchimp within seconds, so abandoned cart and purchase automations, product recommendations, segments and revenue reports work with complete data.

What is sent

  • Orders: customer email, name, items, total and payment status. A placed order, paid or waiting for a bank transfer, ends the customer’s abandoned cart. Cancelled and refunded orders are marked as such in Mailchimp.
  • Abandoned carts: when a shopper enters an email address at checkout and leaves, the cart is sent to Mailchimp, which starts its abandoned cart automation. Changes to the cart are sent too.
  • Products: name, price, link, image and description, kept up to date when they change.
  • Subscribers: customers who tick the newsletter checkbox at checkout join the audience as subscribed contacts; other customers are stored as transactional contacts.

Built not to lose data

  • Every change goes into a queue. If Mailchimp or the store is unreachable, it is sent again automatically with growing delays.
  • Changes that cannot be sent are listed in the panel with the reason, and can be sent again with one click.
  • Email alerts tell the store admin when Mailchimp rejects the API key or changes cannot be sent.

Newsletter consent

A newsletter checkbox is added to the classic and the block checkout. By default only customers who tick it become subscribed contacts. Adding all customers as subscribed is a separate setting.

Existing data

Products and paid orders from the last 12 months can be imported once after connecting. During the import the store is marked as syncing in Mailchimp, so imported orders do not start automations.

Plans

Free for up to 50 paid orders a month. Starter: 500 orders for $9/month, Growth: 2,500 for $19/month, Pro: unlimited for $39/month. Abandoned carts, products and subscribers are not limited.

External services

This plugin sends data to the external services below. Nothing is sent until the store is connected in WooCommerce → Mail Sync.

Ulte service (app.stockeven.com), operated by Event Space Sp. z o.o., Poland. It receives the store’s changes, keeps the queue and sends them to Mailchimp.
Data sent: product ID, name, price, URL, image URL and short description; order ID, status, date, total, items, customer email, first and last name and the newsletter consent flag; cart contents, checkout link and the email entered at checkout; the site URL, store currency, site name, admin email, plugin and WooCommerce versions; the Mailchimp API key (on connection).
Privacy policy: https://ulte.net/privacy/ · Terms: https://ulte.net/terms/

Mailchimp (api.mailchimp.com), operated by Intuit Inc. The Ulte service sends the data listed above to the Mailchimp account that owns the API key.
Privacy policy: https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/ · Terms: https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/

Stripe (checkout.stripe.com, billing.stripe.com), only when a paid plan is chosen or billing is managed. The browser is sent to a Stripe page; the store’s admin email is passed to pre-fill the checkout. Stripe processes the payment and issues invoices.
Privacy policy: https://stripe.com/privacy · Terms: https://stripe.com/legal

Mailchimp is a trademark of Intuit Inc. WooCommerce is a trademark of Automattic Inc. Ulte is not affiliated with or endorsed by Intuit or Automattic.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. In Mailchimp open Profile → Extras → API keys and create a key.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Mail Sync, paste the key and click Connect. A Mailchimp store linked to the first audience is created.
  4. Optionally import existing products and orders.
sections.faq:
Which Mailchimp plan is needed?

Any plan, including Free. E-commerce data is available on every Mailchimp plan; abandoned cart automations depend on the Mailchimp plan.

Which audience is used?

The first audience of the Mailchimp account. Mailchimp links each store to one audience.

What happens above the monthly limit?

Orders above the limit wait in the queue and are sent right after an upgrade, or on the 1st of the next month. Nothing is lost. While an order waits, its abandoned cart is removed from Mailchimp, so the customer does not get cart reminders for a purchase that was made.

Is the Mailchimp API key stored in WordPress?

No. The key is sent once to the Ulte service, stored there encrypted and used only to send this store’s data to Mailchimp. Disconnecting or uninstalling deletes it.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes. Abandoned carts and the newsletter checkbox work with the classic and the block checkout. The checkbox in the block checkout requires WooCommerce 8.9 or later.
